purpose: Close the checkpoint-81 self-sealing boundary: derive the exact publication set from repository evidence rather than accepting the prompt's assumed arithmetic, and record the reconciliation.

promptAssumedArithmetic.assumedEquation: 237 base untracked + 76 excluded = 313 current untracked; final set = 237 base + 10 checkpoint-81 delta + 1 tracked = 248

criticalPriorConcernRaisedAndRefuted.concern: The primary executor initially worried that the checkpoint-81 base allowlist (238 paths) might have been generated PARTWAY through checkpoint 81's own work, after some but not all of checkpoint 81's own evidence files already existed on disk -- which would mean some of the '10 delta' files were already double-counted inside the 238-path base, breaking the clean 237+10=247 arithmetic.
criticalPriorConcernRaisedAndRefuted.investigationMethod: Read the sealed COMMIT_5R1C37_CHECKPOINT_81_EXACT_FUTURE_STAGING_ALLOWLIST.json directly and checked whether any of the 10 named checkpoint-81 delta files appear in its own allowlist array.
criticalPriorConcernRaisedAndRefuted.result: REFUTED. None of the 10 checkpoint-81 delta files appear in the sealed 238-path base allowlist. The base allowlist and the 10-file delta are cleanly disjoint sets.
criticalPriorConcernRaisedAndRefuted.evidenceOfDisjointness: Verified programmatically: for each of the 10 delta filenames, Array.find() against the 238 allowlist entries returned undefined for all 10.

setB_checkpoint81SelfSealingDelta.derivationMethod: Cross-referenced checkpoint-81's own final evidence manifest, its recovery checkpoint, live git status, and file hashes.
setB_checkpoint81SelfSealingDelta.allHashesMatchCheckpoint81Manifest: 9/10 direct manifest-entry matches; the 10th (the manifest file itself) correctly has no self-entry by design (self-excluding manifest), and its own hash independently matched the separately-recorded manifest self-hash.

setC_exclusions.derivationMethod: Computed as (live untracked at preflight, 323) minus (Set A untracked members, 237) minus (Set B, 10) = 76. Independently cross-checked: every category in the sealed allowlist's exclusionSection was confirmed to still be excluded from the live commit.

closingEquationVerification.verificationMethod: Computed live via git status --porcelain -uall at preflight time (323), independently cross-checked against FINAL_SET's untracked-member count (247) plus the derived exclusion count (76).
